Title: Collector server history and results with knowledge links
Description: As a desktop user, I want to list my collector batches and see candidates linked back to the knowledge item and local source they came from, served by the collector server.
AcceptanceCriteria: US122 chunk writer prefixes chunk text with a context line: 'Structured knowledge summary from page N' or 'from file X (lines a-b)'
GET /collector/batches returns only the caller's batches (owner_user_id and org_id from the token) with batch_id, batch_name, created_at, saga state and per-stage counts

GET /collector/batches/{id}/results returns harvesting/seeding results joined to chunk rows: knowledge item (kind, title, summary) and source (page or file + lines); knowledge item id = chunk id {document_id}|{source_chunk_index}
Results for another user's batch return 404
Same JWT and stamp check as US123
All code for this story lives inside Cortexa-dev/desktop/collector; nothing in services/, contracts/, frontend/ or deploy/ is edited or referenced (outside logic is re-implemented inside)
TalkingPoints: Extraction is unchanged; the context line rides in chunk text and the knowledge link is built in the collector server by joining results to chunk rows. Limit: the context line also shows in web excerpts.
